title: Dominic and the Terminal
author: Casper Kavanagh
blurb: Kestrel Eriksen, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
